messages:
Maya: Quick thought — analytics side: can we surface per-route heatmap rows with sampling rate + fallback counts next to the per-model breakdown? would help explain weird token burn. e.g. /signup -> sampled 70% but 30% fell back to quantized-7b, so raw tokens != billed-estimate.

Owen: +1. where should sampling live in the model? saved_query metadata or route config?

Maya: leaning route-level defaults + saved_query override. suggested saved_query metadata: `telemetry_hint: { sampling_rate: 0.7, preferred_model: \"redwood-7b-v2\" }` so the UI knows how to display adjusted counts.

Sam: watch out — saved queries are shared and owned by teams. per-user sampling prefs will confuse customers. quotas are route-scoped today, so route default seems safer.

Julia: can do route default + opt-in saved_query override for experiments. that lets product/SEs run A/Bs without touching route config.

Kevin: API contract proposal (sketch):
```
PATCH /api/routes/:id
{
  "telemetry_defaults": {
    "sampling_rate": 0.5,
    "cost_preview_mode": "per-sample" // or "raw"
  }
}
```
Saved query override example:
```
{
  "query": "...",
  "overrides": { "telemetry_sampling": 0.75 }
}
```

Maya: UX rules: heatmap should show two numbers per cell — displayed_tokens and estimated_tokens_adjusted (displayed / sampling_rate). hovering shows math + source (route default vs saved_query override). color ramp should weight fallback-rate so rows with lots of fallbacks get a warning color.

Owen: regarding routing fallbacks: console currently aggregates by route only. we need per-model_variant counts so we can tell how often requests fell back from primary -> compat variant. telemetry today doesn't emit that granularity.

Sam: ops note — adding `model_variant` to each route_event will increase cardinality, but we already sometimes tag model. need to validate ingestion costs.

Julia: could we infer fallbacks from response latencies or error codes? maybe unreliable for multi-variant stacks. better to emit explicit field.

Kevin: rollout UX: when we change route routing policy, any saved queries pinned to a specific model should show a banner: "This saved view is pinned to model X, which may be rotated during rollout." give an action: pin to current or unpin to follow route default.

Maya: agree — banner + quick unpin action. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout `route-telemetry-v2` started (canary 10% traffic). https://deploys.internal/r/route-telemetry-v2

Sam: proposed scope for backend work: 1) add `model_variant` to route telemetry payload, 2) add `telemetry_defaults` to route API, 3) allow saved_query overrides. frontend scope: heatmap UI changes, banner + tooltip text, cost-adjusted token math.

Owen: any perf/SLO concerns? adding a small field is fine but we need to check event size at 99p.

Maya: i'll mock up the heatmap rows and banner this afternoon and post in #product-design. will include example with sampling 0.1 vs 0.9, fallback heavy row.

Julia: DB migration note — `telemetry_defaults.sampling_rate` should default to `null` to avoid changing existing semantics. add migration docs for operators.

Kevin: i'll open the API PR + migration draft and tag @eng-ml for perf validation.

Maya: thanks — if folks can review the mockup + API sketch within 48h we can align for the canary expansion.

Sam: noted, will review.

Maya: FYI i'll also add a small copy for the tooltip explaining the adjusted estimate calculation and the assumption (sample uniformity). :sparkles:

Owen: small follow-up — when saved_query overrides sampling, add an audit trail (who changed, when) so we can track experiments.

Maya: good call. will include an audit hint in the saved_query metadata model.

Kevin: tagging the checklist: API PR, DB migration, telemetry schema bump, frontend mockup, docs + FAQ, canary + perf gate.

Maya: awesome, thanks everyone. i'll post assets soon.
